title: A game-theoretic analysis of the market microstructure in decentralized exchanges with concentrated liquidity
abstract: arXiv:2610.28863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study strategic liquidity provision in decentralized exchanges with concentrated liquidity as a mean-field game. Liquidity providers choose the width of their price range and when to rebalance it, pay a transaction cost at each rebalancing, and share the fees collected at each tick in proportion to their liquidity, so that each provider's income depends on the state of the population. We formulate the problem as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain on a finite state space. In an averaged version of the game, in which a rebalanced position is re-centered at a draw from the long-run law of the price, a mean-field equilibrium exists. Because each provider's share of the fees falls as competing liquidity is added, the equilibrium liquidity profile is unique. translated_title: 具有集中流动性的去中心化交易所市场微观结构的博弈论分析
translated_abstract: 我们将具有集中流动性的去中心化交易所中的策略性流动性提供问题建模为平均场博弈。流动性提供者选择其价格区间的宽度以及何时重新平衡该区间，在每次重新平衡时支付交易成本，并按其流动性份额按比例分享在每个价格刻度（tick）处收取的费用，因此每个提供者的收入取决于群体状态。我们将该问题表述为有限状态空间上的受控连续时间马尔可夫链。在博弈的一个平均化版本中——即重新平衡后的头寸以从价格长期分布中抽取的点重新居中——平均场均衡存在。由于随着竞争性流动性的增加，每个提供者所分得的费用份额会下降，因此均衡流动性分布是唯一的。对于精确的动态情形，即在区间边界处重新平衡且执行速度较快的情况下，我们得到了最优区间宽度、价值函数以及……的平稳分布的封闭形式解。
tldr: 该论文首次将集中流动性去中心化交易所中的策略性流动性提供建模为平均场博弈，证明了均衡的存在性与唯一性，并推导出最优区间宽度、价值函数及平稳分布的封闭形式解。
en_tdlr: This paper models strategic liquidity provision in concentrated-liquidity decentralized exchanges as a mean-field game, proving existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium and deriving closed-form solutions for the optimal range width, value function, and stationary distribution.
